column1: # The Plugin Manager (Options item 6, Issue #1499): PluginManager.exe, a program of its own (x86-64, GUI, Delphi), not a plugin. Its role is 補助, and its folder
# has no 本体 row, so it has no Plugin database entry. The key ends with .dll: the engine finds a realmod by the rebased file's name without its base, so the key is the
# name the realmod has. Its VFS row is in lift/harness/seeds/vfs-seed-idle1.tsv (a lazy file of the resources) and its pack line in lift/harness/web/pack.args; the lift
# reads the host file that the extraction puts at lift/out-plugins/<key> (ci/extract-dlls.tsv). hook: none (no CreatePlugInstance export, no Fruity effect hook points).
# omit: - (fe-lift lift reports setjmp_landings 0). See pm-work/findings/plugin-manager-exe.md.
